Hi Natasha / Acme infra team,

Thanks again for agreeing to a deeper architecture session. The goal is a focused, technical review so your engineering and security teams have everything they need to finalize network and IAM design for the private deployment path. Proposed scope:
- VPC connectivity options: VPC peering vs TGW vs PrivateLink
- On-prem network requirements and firewall egress patterns
- IAM & key management: how runtime authenticates to KMS, service accounts, and least-privilege mapping
- Deployment artifacts: network diagram, SG/NACL guidance, and SOC/regs checklist

Suggested attendees: your infra lead, procurement (to cover procurement gating), our SE (Dylan), and our Security lead (Mina). I've attached a short agenda (Agenda_v1.pdf).

Proposed time slots (PST):
- Thu Feb 12, 10:00–11:00 PST
- Thu Feb 12, 15:00–16:00 PST
- Fri Feb 13, 08:00–09:00 PST

If none of those work please propose two windows that include your preferred time zone and I’ll send a calendar hold. Also flag any docs you want reviewed ahead of time (network diagrams, firewall rules, compliance matrices).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
